summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found before writing this plan (read-only investigation, no files touched)  I traced the full chain: `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → SQLite, plus the auth/session code in `modules/auth/handlers.ts` and `db/auth.ts`.  **Everything I read looks correctly wired:** - `watchlists.user_id` is `NOT NULL`, every route (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /watchlist*`) requires a valid session and scopes every query by `user_id`
